summary: Optimum Communications filed an 8-K announcing a series of transactions, including a cash tender offer for unaffiliated stockholders at $2.50 per share, a private exchange of common stock for preferred units, and a $300M institutional private placement of preferred units in a newly formed unrestricted subsidiary. The internal reorganization insulates unrestricted assets from CSC Holdings debt restructuring. A special committee of independent managers approved the reorganization. The tender offer is part of a capital return to shareholders, with proceeds from the private placement intended to finance it. What to watch: execution of the tender offer and potential registered exchange offer, along with ongoing debt restructuring discussions. Risk-arb angle: focus on tender offer pricing at $2.50/share and any take-up rate.
